from object_detector_tool import *

image_path = "/home/stud/wxie/BLINK_Dataset/Counting/val/images/val_Counting_87_image_1.jpg"
labels = ["apple"]
threshold = 0.3
model_size = "base"
padding = 10

execution = object_detector_tool.execute(image=image_path, labels=labels, threshold=threshold, model_size=model_size, padding=padding)

obj_ids = [obj["id"] for obj in execution['output_type'][0]]
object_classes = [obj["label"] for obj in execution['output_type'][0]]
confidence_scores = [obj["confidence score"] for obj in execution['output_type'][0]]

for obj_id in obj_ids:
    obj = execution['output_type'][obj_id]
    x, y, width, height = obj["bbox"]
    start_x = x - int(padding * max(1.0 / threshold, width / (max(1.0, threshold))))
    start_y = y - int(padding * max(1.0 / threshold, height / (max(1.0, threshold))))
    for label in object_classes:
        if label == "apple":
            print(f"Found {confidence_scores[label][obj_id]:.2f} apples at ({start_x:.1f}, {start_y:.1f})")
